title: What indexed_search Indexes Without a Crawler
hints: typo3/cms-indexed-search indexes a page when the frontend renders it into the page cache with config.index_enable set. A page nobody has requested yet is not in the index.
An uncached render indexes nothing, and neither does a page with its no_search flag set.
A translated page is indexed only where it renders its own content. A page that shows fallback content in that language is skipped.
An indexing configuration record does nothing on its own. No core code processes one, and a crawler extension outside the core does.

The package is a system extension a project requires on its own, and typo3_system_extension_lookup says on which lines. For search packages outside the core, ask typo3_ter_lookup with a query such as site search.
